explanation: Try subtracting each jug’s lower and upper capacities from the target range. Memoize failed residual ranges and stop on invalid bounds or a jug already contained within the desired interval.
timeComplexity: O(J·S) expected, for J jugs and S distinct explored residual ranges
spaceComplexity: O(S+D), including memoized failures and recursion depth D
